messages:
Ashley: Quick async — want to align owners & blockers for the console observability deliverables this sprint (dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, retention change). Who's owning each and any cross-team deps?
Ben: I can own dashboards. PR is open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/312 — needs a small analytics schema change (events.user_id -> events.actor_id).
Chris: Tracing hooks are implemented in runtime, branch `trace/hooks-v2`. Staging rollout blocked by sampling config; pinging @infra for sampling agent change.
Dana: Error analysis views (alerts + grouped errors) — prototype done, need product signoff on grouping rules. Also we need to increase error log retention to 90d for the analysis pipeline (cost estimate in PLT-487).
Lina: Happy to review grouping rules. Can you drop screenshots and a short decision doc? prefer grouping by `exception_type` + `root_cause_hint`.
Ben: @Dana I'll wire screenshots into PR comments today. Dashboards rely on that `actor_id` rename — data pipeline change is tracked in infra ticket INF-902.
infra-bot: CI failed on console/pull/312 — `integration-tests:observability` failed (flaky indexing).
Chris: Re: sampling config — INF-905 is the change to the agent. @infra-team, can you prioritize INF-905 this week? Without it tracing in prod will be noisy and will blow quota.
Dana: Retention increase: rough cost delta is ~ +8% monthly for logging. If we only increase retained logs for `observability-*` indices it drops to +2%. Need microdecision by Fri EOD.
Ashley: Owners summary so far: dashboards -> @Ben, tracing hooks/rollout -> @Chris, error-analysis -> @Dana, product review -> @Lina, infra deps -> infra team. Is that right? Any volunteers for rollout verification in staging?
Ben: I can do dashboard verification in staging Tue morning.
Chris: I'll run end-to-end trace tests once sampling change is deployed. Can pair with Ben for the staging smoke.
Lina: I'll do UX signoff Wed after Dana posts the screenshots+doc.
Dana: Working on the doc now, will post by EOD. Also leaving a note: if we keep 90d for error logs we should add an alert for expensive growth >25% month-over-month.
Ashley: Good call @Dana. Action items: 1) @Dana post doc + screenshots (EOD today). 2) @infra-team prioritize INF-905 (sampling) this week. 3) @Ben merge dashboard PR once CI passes and verify Tue. 4) @Chris run trace e2e after INF-905 and confirm rollout. 5) @Lina UX signoff Wed. I'll follow up in tomorrow sync with a short status slide. :thumbsup:
Ben: One blocker: CI flakiness — if infra can't fix INF-902 quickly I may split the schema change into a migration-only PR to unblock dashboard queries.
Ashley: ok noted. If needed do the split PR and tag me. We'll treat the schema rename as a backward-compatible migration.
Chris: small code snippet for infra change I asked for:
```yaml
# sampling agent config
sampling:
  default_rate: 0.05
  service_overrides:
    console: 0.5
```
Please make sure agent respects `service_overrides`.
Dana: Posted screenshots + grouping doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/obs-grouping (comments inline).
Lina: Reviewed doc, left two quick UX comments. Looks good overall.
infra-bot: INF-905 status changed -> in-progress (assigned to infra-eng).
Ashley: Thanks everyone. I'll close the loop after the morning sync. If anything slips, mention this thread and tag me.
